research_scope: Eleven early/base-game skills from PQ61-PQ70. Reward-slot and Ultimate-Finish semantics remain unresolved unless directly established.

duplicate_check.repository_search_note: All eleven selected names returned no repository-search matches before insertion.

records.name: Recoome Kick
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 61 — The Cell Games Continued
records.skill_description: A fast flying knee/side kick that temporarily boosts normal attack after connecting.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Recoome Kick as a Strike Super using 100 Ki. The documented attack deals 10% damage and temporarily boosts normal attack.

records.name: Fighting Pose H
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 61 — The Cell Games Continued
records.skill_description: A pose that temporarily reduces damage taken.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Fighting Pose H as a Power Up Super using 0 Ki and documents a 20-second duration.

records.name: Teleporting Vanishing Ball
records.skill_description: Creates a Ki Blast and teleports directly to the opponent before throwing it.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Teleporting Vanishing Ball as a Ki Blast Ultimate using 300 Ki, with 15 hits and documented knockback.

records.name: Kai Kai
records.skill_description: A teleportation technique used for rapid repositioning.
records.mechanics_notes: Independent technique references classify Kai Kai as a Super Skill and describe it as a teleportation technique. The accessible sources used in this batch do not establish a reliable resource cost, so Ki/stamina costs remain unresolved.

records.name: Ill Rain
records.skill_description: Launches a Ki Blast upward that scatters into three smaller projectiles.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Ill Rain as a Ki Blast Super using 100 Ki. The initial projectile lingers before splitting into three projectiles.

records.name: Scissors Paper Rock
records.skill_description: A three-stage close-range attack allowing Rock, Scissors, or Paper inputs.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Scissors Paper Rock as a Strike Super using 100 Ki. The three options combine into a three-hit sequence.

records.name: Candy Beam
records.skill_description: Fires a circular beam that turns nearby enemies into candy temporarily.
records.mechanics_notes: The PQ66 reward is the Evasive Candy Beam variant, not the later Candy Beam Super from PQ113. Current skill-specific data classifies the PQ66 version as an Other Evasive using 300 stamina and a Majin CaC restriction.

records.name: Super God Fist
records.character_source: Goku; Goku (Super Saiyan God); Goku (Super Saiyan 4); Majuub; Hit
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 67 — Power of a Super Saiyan God
records.skill_description: Coats the right fist in Ki and launches a fast close-range punch.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Super God Fist as a Strike Super using 100 Ki, with grab-like properties and a single hit.

records.name: Angry Shout
records.character_source: Kid Buu; Kid Buu (Supervillain); Janemba; Janemba (Supervillain); Majin Buu (Gohan Absorbed)
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 68 — Old Rivals and Dragon Balls
records.skill_description: Releases a powerful shout that pushes enemies away and restores Ki.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Angry Shout as a Strike Evasive using 300 stamina. It can damage and knock back nearby opponents while restoring the user's Ki.

records.name: Headshot
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 69 — God of Destruction and His Master
records.skill_description: Flicks the opponent with a forceful forehead strike and knocks them away.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Headshot as a Strike Evasive using 300 stamina and documents a single-hit close-range knockback attack.

records.name: Emperor's Blast
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 70 — Things Are Getting Serious!
records.skill_description: Turns the user around and fires a powerful Ki wave behind them.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Emperor's Blast as a Ki Blast Super using 100 Ki. It is a rear-facing single-hit attack that also stuns the target for approximately three seconds.
